reasoning.headline: Hybrid trip mode: Mapbox proposes walks; score-aware adds neighbourhood links Mapbox misses (OD-11 Fairmead cut-through). Day Index varies more across Casey; Night sits higher and more compressed.
evidence: OD-11 (30 Jul 2026): Mapbox ~486 m road loop; challenger ~282 m cut-through; Casey T1EAM scores the mid-block strip Mapbox skipped.
OSM mid-strip links are often tagged cycleway/service, not footway — Mapbox walking under-uses them; our graph includes them.
Cost v2 uses percentile normalisation so Day/Night get equal swing; plus 1.15× detour cap vs graph-shortest (OD-05 fix).
Night Index shares Accessibility 60% with Day; lighting lifts the floor so many corridors look ‘good enough’ at night.

ods.label: Fairmead Place → Hopwood Court (cul-de-sac cut-through)
ods.why: Live QA 30 Jul 2026: Mapbox walking returned road loop via Raleigh Dr (~469 m, Footpaths 8.1) while Streets basemap shows mid-block ped links through Delmare/Lowden. T1EAM probe: 9 scored segments (~659 m, mean Acc ~83) in the cut-through strip Mapbox skipped — Casey can score the gap; Mapbox did not propose the geometry.

ods.why: Live QA 30 Jul 2026: two Mapbox options both on road centreline (~1.8–1.9 km); park / neighbourhood paths unused. Stress test for candidate diversity + whether score-aware finds non-road corridor. T1EAM mid-corridor has many scored segments (Casey coverage exists).
